description: Meeting platform — booking links, teams, round-robin, collective.

entity_mappings.description: A booking references its invitee as a Fibre person via invitee_person_id.
A Meet host IS a Fibre user — one host row per user with meet-host config (slug, working_hours, google_refresh_token, etc.).
Team membership references existing users; no identity creation. (Note: team + team_member are now platform-owned, not Meet-owned. Consider removing this entry — see fibreflow-review.md §2.2.)

curator_fields.description: Change-facilitation context (role, stance, readiness, themes, blockers, motivators, current challenge, facilitator notes) curated by Meet for each person it meets with.
